name: stack32
description: Stack32 — Describe the agent you need. Build it. Use it immediately.

scripts.dev:agent: sh -c 'cd services/agent-service && [ -d .venv ] && .venv/bin/uvicorn agent_service.main:app --reload --port 8000 || echo "agent-service venv missing — see services/agent-service/README.md"'
scripts.test:agent: sh -c 'cd services/agent-service && [ -d .venv ] && .venv/bin/pytest || echo "agent-service venv missing — see services/agent-service/README.md"'
scripts.supabase:types: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > apps/web/lib/supabase/database.types.ts
